name: @runsecure/hkdfguard-pipeline-awssecretsmanager
description: HkdfGuard secret pipeline writer over AWS Secrets Manager (AWS SDK for JavaScript v3): pulls a fixed list of secrets, taken out of the response before the SDK can make them strings, encrypts each at once with a PipelineDataProtector bound to its file name, and writes one file per secret for FilePerSecretCache.
